scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Global coincidence and uniqueness of the implicit relay trajectory conditional on monotonicity of a reference delay-coordinate map; no all-nesting coincidence claim.
scientific_integrity.method: Analytic proof using monotone inverse and exact sign identity; separate rational witness checker.

scientific_limitations: Order condition verified along a given reference solution, not every history.
Does not address smooth switches, nonmonotone implicit branches, or general nested-delay dynamics.
The periodic forcing is constructed to fit the reference; no claim about physical sinusoidal forcing.
Historical uniqueness remains qualified by inspected literature.
title: Monotone delay coordinates preserve relay dynamics beyond contraction
